source.description: All India Pincode Directory (post-office-wise), Department of Posts, via data.gov.in (snapshot dated 30 May 2019; row count 155,599 offices; direct download, no API key). Also listed on https://data.gov.in/resource/all-india-pincode-directory-till-last-month
source.supplement: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropdevrahul/pincodes-india/main/pincode.csv (MIT-licensed repo republishing a newer 2024-05 data.gov.in extract; PARTIAL: 95,040 offices / 12,127 pincodes). Used ONLY to add 40 pincodes absent from the 2019 file (rows flagged gh_only_pins); not used to override anything else.

licence: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India), https://data.gov.in/government-open-data-license-india - attribution to Department of Posts, Government of India / data.gov.in required. The GitHub supplement repo is MIT, its data is the same GODL-India government data.

rows_dropped.note: Those 74 office rows were skipped only for district voting; every pincode they belong to still appears via other offices (0 pincodes lost). 0 invalid pincodes (all 6 digits, first digit 1-9).

columns.district: Most frequent district among the pincode's offices (ties broken alphabetically), Title Cased; source spelling retained, e.g. 'Ananthapur', 'Ahmadabad' vs 'Ahmedabad' variants are NOT harmonised
columns.office_count: Number of post-office rows for the pincode in the source

normalisation: Source state spellings fixed: Chattisgarh->Chhattisgarh, Megalaya->Meghalaya, Pondicherry->Puducherry, 'Andaman and Nico.In.'->Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
Dadra and Nagar Haveli + Daman and Diu merged into 'Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu'.
Ladakh split out of Jammu and Kashmir by district (Leh, Kargil), verified against the 2024 extract (which labels 14 overlapping pincodes Ladakh).
Chandigarh, Puducherry (incl. Mahe/Yanam/Karaikal enclaves) assigned by district because the 2019 file mislabels some offices.

State per pincode = district's dominant state when >=90% consistent across the file (fixes dirty rows, e.g. pincode 847202 has offices labelled with 10 different states), otherwise majority vote among the pincode's offices.
known_issues: Snapshot is from May 2019 (plus 40 newer pincodes): pincodes created since then are missing, and some 2019 district names predate renames/splits (e.g. new Telangana/Andhra districts). Refresh from data.gov.in (browser download requires name/email/captcha) before launch if exact currency matters.
District spellings are inconsistent in India Post's source; fine for autofill, not for analytics.
About 1,556 pincodes span more than one district; only the most frequent is kept.
Some pincodes legitimately cross state lines (e.g. Pondicherry enclaves in Tamil Nadu/Kerala/Andhra); the state shown is the dominant one.
official_direct_api: The data.gov.in API (api.data.gov.in) needs a personal API key; none was used.
